hook: The Denver Broncos made history by winning 16 straight games decided by eight points or less.

sections.voiceover: The Denver Broncos made history by winning 16 straight games decided by eight points or less.
b_roll: Graphics showing NFL record counter escalating to 16 wins

sections.voiceover: On November 8, 2026, the Denver Broncos played the Carolina Panthers at Bank of America Stadium. How did Denver secure this 26-21 win in Charlotte?
b_roll: Map pin on Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte
Diagram of victory formation positioning on field

sections.voiceover: Denver's defense held strong, but the game stayed tight until a decisive fourth-quarter strip-sack occurred.
b_roll: Motion graphic showing defensive line rush path

sections.voiceover: Nik Bonitto hit Bryce Young to knock the ball loose, securing a crucial fourth-quarter turnover. The final 26-21 result officially broke the league record.
Bo Nix took the final snap to secure their 16th straight win by one score.
b_roll: Historic timeline graphic celebrating Denver Broncos record
